verdict.rationale: PostHog exposes a documented HTTP API (posthog-docs-11), a verified OpenAPI spec (posthog-probe-3), and HogQL/SQL query capability for querying events, persons, and warehouse data directly (posthog-docs-8, posthog-docs-17, posthog-docs-9), plus MCP/CLI tooling for running queries programmatically (posthog-docs-19, posthog-probe-4, posthog-probe-5). This directly matches the developer story of pulling raw event data and running analytical queries via a documented API.
